--check-hash-based-pycs.description: control how Python invalidates hash-based .pyc files

-B.description: : don't write .pyc files on import; also PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=x

-E.description: : ignore PYTHON* environment variables (such as PYTHONPATH)

-I.description: : isolate Python from the user's environment (implies -E and -s)

-O.description: : remove assert and __debug__-dependent statements; add .opt-1 before

-OO.description: : do -O changes and also discard docstrings; add .opt-2 before

-P.description: : don't prepend a potentially unsafe path to sys.path; also

-V.description: : print the Python version number and exit (also --version)

-b.description: : issue warnings about converting bytes/bytearray to str and comparing

-d.description: : turn on parser debugging output (for experts only, only works on

-h.description: : print this help message and exit (also -? or --help)

-i.description: : inspect interactively after running script; forces a prompt even

-q.description: : don't print version and copyright messages on interactive startup

-s.description: : don't add user site directory to sys.path; also PYTHONNOUSERSITE=x

-u.description: : force the stdout and stderr streams to be unbuffered;

-x.description: : skip first line of source, allowing use of non-Unix forms of #!cmd
